scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./index.html --outdir=dist --minify && cp -R src/app/styles/fonts dist/fonts && cp src/fixtures/snapshot.json dist/snapshot.json

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: bunx biome check --staged --no-errors-on-unmatched && if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1; then gitleaks git --staged -v --redact --no-banner; fi
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: bun run typecheck && bun test --pass-with-no-tests && { bash scripts/diff-budget.sh || true; }
